paragraphs.text: Workspace routing migration for DeepSeek Harness. Move a project folder, then repoint its workspace
at the new location — the conversations that lived in the old folder keep working, without a single
byte of session history being rewritten.
# dsh-workspace-relink
English | 中文

**Workspace routing migration for DeepSeek Harness.** Move a project folder, then
repoint its worksp

ace at the new location — the conversations that lived in the
old folder keep working, without a sin
gle byte of session history being rewritten.
## The problem it solves

A DSH workspace is one registry record pointing at one directory, and a stored
session is grouped in

to a workspace by the canonical form of `cwd` recorded in
its immutable header. Move the files and b
oth halves break at once:

- the workspace reports `missing-dir`;
- the conversations it lists cannot resolve their working dir

ectory, so every
tool call fails until the directory is back.

There is no relocation API — the header is append-only storage — so the only
honest fix is to make t

he old directory *spelling* resolve again while the
workspace record moves to the new canonical path

. That is exactly what a
directory route (a Windows directory junction) does, and it is why this plu

gin is
about **routing**, not about editing history.
## What it does
[代码示例省略，未执行]

1. You move the files yourself (this plugin never moves or deletes your data).
2. `工作区路由迁徙` (Plugins

→ the plugin's page) plans the move: it checks the new
directory, says whether the old path is free

, and lists what it will do.
3. On apply it creates the junction at the old path, creates (or reuses

own attach/detach validation, and retires the old
registration once nothing is left in it.

The same page can move a **single conversation** into another workspace, and
manages the junctions i
t created (inspect them, remove them).
## Requirements and limits

- The old and new directories must be reachable from the same machine; a
junction is a local filesys

tem object.
- Junction creation needs no elevation on Windows (`fs.symlink(..., 'junction')`).
- A l

eftover old directory (copy instead of move) blocks the plan until you let
the plugin rename it asid

e as `<name>.moved-<timestamp>`; nothing is deleted.
- Removing a junction is allowed only for route

s this plugin recorded, and only
while the path still is a junction. Conversations that resolved the

ir working
directory through it go back to reporting a missing directory.
- A conversation whose rec

orded directory is a *different existing directory*
cannot be re-homed into a workspace it does not

resolve to — DSH refuses that
ownership transfer, and so does this plugin, instead of silently detac

hing it.
- Sessions whose logs carry no `cwd` are reported as untransferable rather than
guessed at.
## The page
Plugins → 工作区路由迁徙.

- Every workspace with its path, status badge, session count, and expandable
session list.
- Per wor

kspace: `修改位置` → new path, `浏览…`, `预览计划`, `执行迁徙`, with
blockers and warnings spelled out before anyt

hing is written.
- Per session: move it to another workspace.
- Recorded routes with target liveness
and a remove button.
## Agent tools
Available to the model unless `agentTools` is false:
| Tool | Purpose |
| `workspace_relink_status` | Workspaces, paths, status, session counts, recorded routes. `includeSe

ssions: true` also returns each session's id, title, recorded cwd, `cwdState` and `live` flag |
| `w

orkspace_relink_plan` | Dry run for repointing one workspace |
| `workspace_relink_apply` | Execute

it (`confirmed: true` required) |
| `workspace_relink_move_session` | Move one conversation into ano

ther workspace |
| `workspace_relink_route_remove` | Remove one recorded route |

Every tool answers with a one-line human summary plus the full JSON payload as a
second text block,

so the model can read `plan.blockers[].code`, workspace ids and
session titles instead of guessing f

el can read `plan.blockers[].code`, workspace ids and
session titles instead of guessing from prose.
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `agentTools` | `true` | Expose the tools above to the model; the page always works |
| `allowSessi
onRoutes` | `true` | Allow creating a route when moving a conversation whose directory is gone |
## Bookkeeping

Routes this plugin created are recorded in
`<DSH_HOME>/workspace-relink/routes.json` (absolute paths

, kind, ids, timestamp).
It is an index over the filesystem, never the authority: a hand-made symlin

k is
never touched, and a recorded route whose link is gone is simply reported.
## Self-test
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The harness exercises the engine against a stand-in registry that reproduces
DSH's membership canon

(`realpath(header.cwd)` equality, plus the missing-cwd
wildcard): broken state, plan, apply, route r

euse, refusal cases, leftover
directory displacement, single-session adoption, and route removal. It

writes
nothing outside a temporary directory.
